connectors.name: Jenkins
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Jenkins REST API connector — trigger builds, monitor status, fetch console logs and artifacts. Server-side via API token. Folder-nested jobs supported. Multiple Jenkins instances in one install.

connectors.name: MantisBT
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Read + comment on MantisBT bugs from the user's logged-in browser session. Search, list attachments, download files, post notes. v0.26.2 — tolerant input normalization: strip stray surrounding quotes from string args ('QA Automation Test' from shell-escape leak → QA Automation Test); accept reopen/wontfix/notabug as aliases for reopened/wont_fix/not_a_bug. v0.26.1 surfaced the resolution arg in search_bugs docs to stop LLMs confusing it with status. v0.26.0 was the URL-direct rewrite (GET view_all_set.php with URL params — Mantis writes its own HttpOnly cookie).

connectors.name: GitLab
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: GitLab REST API connector via Personal Access Token (encrypted at rest). 25+ tools for issues, MRs, projects, pipelines, branches, files, notes, todos.

connectors.name: Microsoft Teams
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Read + send messages in the Teams web client (v2 UI) via the user's logged-in session. Channels, group chats, 1:1 DMs.

connectors.name: GitHub API
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: GitHub REST API connector — runs entirely server-side. Optional PAT for private repos / higher rate limits.

connectors.name: Black Duck
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Synopsys Black Duck SCA — 6 read tools (projects, versions, risk profile, vulnerable BOM components, components). Uses Forge core's new bearer-token-exchange auth: configure base_url + long-lived API token, Forge auto-exchanges for ~2h bearer JWT and caches.
